# Basic Task Genius Examples

Demonstrates Task Genius plugin custom checkboxes and metadata.

## Standard States

- [ ] Todo task
- [x] Completed task
- [-] Cancelled task

## Extended States

- [/] Task in progress
- [>] Delegated to team member
- [<] Waiting for input
- [?] Question needs answer
- [!] Important task
- [+] Recently added
- [~] Recurring task

## Progress Tracking

- [ ] Project Phase 1 (2/5 complete)
  - [ ] Design
  - [x] Requirements
  - [x] Architecture
  - [ ] Implementation
  - [ ] Testing

- [/] Feature Development (3/4 complete)
  - [x] API design
  - [x] Backend implementation
  - [x] Frontend scaffolding
  - [ ] Integration testing

## Mixed Urgency

- [!] Critical bug fix
- [>] Task delegated to developer
- [<] Waiting on stakeholder approval
- [?] Need clarification on requirements
- [/] Currently being worked on

## Complex Nested Structure

- [ ] Product Roadmap (1/3 complete)
  - [/] Q2 Sprint (2/3 complete)
    - [x] Feature A
    - [x] Feature B
    - [ ] Feature C
  - [ ] Q3 Sprint (0/4 complete)
    - [ ] Planning
    - [ ] Design
    - [ ] Implementation
    - [ ] Testing
  - [<] Q4 Strategy (0/5 complete)
    - [?] Market research needed
    - [ ] Roadmap planning
    - [ ] Team alignment
    - [ ] Resource allocation
    - [ ] Risk assessment
